platform_validation.reason: Code Block editing, syntax highlighting, and basic blocks panel operate entirely on-device within the standard Android framework (Jetpack Compose, Room, Android ClipboardManager) and do not depend on external hardware, OEM voice engines, or AI models.

features.title: Document Block Model, Persistence & Basic Blocks Panel Insertion
features.description: Add EditorBlock.CodeBlock(id, language, code) to NoteDocument.kt with backward-compatible JSON serialization (type: 'code'), BasicBlockType.CODE in BasicBlockType.kt, BasicBlocksPanel.kt reorganization into 'Basic' and 'Advanced' sections, auto-save integration in NoteEditorViewModel, and Markdown/PDF export formatting in NoteExporter.kt.
features.user_visible_behavior: Users see 'Basic' and 'Advanced' section headers in the Basic Blocks panel, can tap 'Code' under Advanced to insert an empty Code Block, see notes auto-saved, and can export notes containing Code Blocks to Markdown and PDF.

evidence.notes: CodeBlock JSON serialization round-trip preserves id, language, and code content.
BasicBlocksPanel renders Basic and Advanced section headers with Code tile under Advanced.
insertBasicBlock(BasicBlockType.CODE) adds CodeBlock to document with default language 'Plain Text' and empty code.
Markdown export contains fenced code block with language identifier; PDF export path verified via instrumented tests.
Platform validation explicitly not required (standard Android framework APIs only).

features.notes: Foundational model, persistence, panel reorganization, and export delivered; visual verification is owned by final slice US-3. Re-delivered 2026-08-19 after a repository reset (clean build; all TC-US-1-01..04 re-verified exit 0). PDF export is exercised by the instrumented NoteExporterTest on the emulator because Robolectric cannot start a PdfDocument page.

features.title: Code Block Card UI, Syntax Highlighting, Line Numbers, Language Selection, Copy & Deletion
features.description: Implement CodeBlockCard.kt elevated Material 3 card (#FFFFFF light, #1E1E1E dark, #E7E3F6 border, 12dp rounded corners) with a synchronized line-number gutter computed from code.lines().size, a real-time regex-based lexical syntax highlighter (CodeSyntaxHighlighter) for Kotlin, Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JSON, SQL, Shell/Bash, C/C++, Rust, Go, and Plain Text, a language selector chip with DropdownMenu, a 'Copy' icon button using ClipboardManager with visual feedback, a 'Delete' icon button for block removal, and a syntax-highlighted monospace editor wired to updateCodeBlock auto-save.
features.user_visible_behavior: Monospace code snippets are styled with theme-appropriate syntax token coloring (keywords, strings, comments, numbers, types) and display synchronized line numbers. Users can pick one of 14 languages from the card header dropdown, edit code with live highlighting and auto-save, copy the exact code to the clipboard with one tap, and delete the block.

evidence.notes: Kotlin, Python, and JSON snippets are tokenized into Keyword, String, Comment, and Number tokens at the expected character ranges.
Line count equals newline count + 1; gutter sequence is 1..lineCount including the empty single-line case.
Empty input returns no tokens; Plain Text and unknown languages fall back to a single plain-text token without errors.
updateCodeBlock(blockId, language = "Python") updates the document block language and auto-saves it.
updateCodeBlock(blockId, code = newCode) updates the code content and persists it on auto-save.
Instrumented CodeBlockCardTest copies the exact code string to the system clipboard on emulator-5554.
deleteBlock removes the CodeBlock from the document and auto-saves the updated content.
Platform validation explicitly not required (standard Android framework APIs only).

features.notes: Merged from the former US-2 (syntax highlighter & line-number engine) and US-3 (card UI) after a re-slicing review: the engine alone was a horizontal slice with no user-visible consumer until the card existed. CodeSyntaxHighlighter remains a separate file with its own unit tests, but ships as part of this card slice.

features.title: Read-Only Mode, Connected UI Flows, Visual Verification & Acceptance Verification
features.description: Deliver CodeBlockScreenTest.kt and CodeBlockVisualFlowTest.kt connected instrumented tests verifying the full user journey (panel insertion, editing, language change, clipboard copying, block deletion) and read-only mode (editing disabled, copy enabled, delete hidden), plus in-test screenshot capture of the code block editor and the Basic Blocks panel for reference-anchor verification against approved design mockups.
features.user_visible_behavior: In read-only notes, the Code Block renders syntax-highlighted code with line numbers and an active Copy action while editing is disabled and the Delete action is hidden. The completed flow is verified end-to-end against the approved design with runtime screenshots.
